   the gate is 166 files / 5779 rows (cold, s439).

   file mode (the program continues without it)" -- FALSE since s435: one shape
   in every mode, a perl-shaped trappable RUN-TIME die at the drop site

 * STATUS.md: "33 files of the two test populations carry 106 such drops
   (s420)" -- the census is SIX populations, 81 files / 185 drops (s438),
   `docs/parse-error-drop-census-s399.tsv`.

   phase model (s436), and the s438 batch (named unary / imported term /
   signature param / qualified handle / glob literal) under Compiler.

`perl -ne` over `.faillog/_status.tsv` for fully-passing + the percentage,

date; no other content changes.  Bar: the gate (docs only; license-tag rows).
